name: Notify User
description: Send a push message to the user on their messaging channel (e.g. Telegram) via the connectors server. Use it when you have something worth telling the user proactively - your normal reply text is NOT delivered anywhere when you run autonomously.

text.description: The message to send to the user

binding_id.description: Connector binding to send through. LEAVE THIS ARGUMENT OUT to use the agent's configured target — do not pass the word "default" or any placeholder.

chat_id.description: Target chat id (a number for Telegram). Several recipients: comma-separated. LEAVE THIS ARGUMENT OUT to use the agent's configured target — do not pass the word "default" or any placeholder.
